# CRMEB High-Quality Open-Source Mall System v8 (PHP) **Mid-platform Architecture · Modular Extensions · AI-Native · Multi-Terminal** [中文说明](README_ZH.md)
Built with care for open source — a Star 🌟 in the top-right corner means a lot to us.
--- ### 📝 **Project Overview** **Open Source Freedom** CRMEB open-source mall is 100% open source under the **Apache-2.0** license, free for commercial use — truly “zero-cost” deployment and secondary development. A new mall foundation for the AI era. **Mid-platform Architecture** v8 is rebuilt as a mid-platform e-commerce architecture: the **Product Mid-platform** unifies multi-type products; the **Order Mid-platform** aggregates status and operations across order sources; the **After-sales & Refund Mid-platform** provides unified after-sales tickets and idempotent refunds. Product types (physical goods, cloud disk) and trade modes (normal, membership) are decoupled into two independent dimensions and can be freely combined via registries. **Modular Plugin System** Business capabilities are organized as pluggable **modules** (`modules/`) and **drivers** (`driver/`): currently 22 official modules (physical goods, cloud-disk products, H5 channel, WeChat Mini Program channel, check-in, AI Agent, MCP service, and more) and 30 official drivers (WeChat Pay, cloud storage, SMS, email, logistics tracking, e-waybill, e-invoice, product scraping, bots, cloud printing, and more). A fresh install defaults to 7 modules (1 required + 6 default) and 15 drivers. All support visual install / uninstall / enable / disable in the admin panel. Extensions follow a unified spec with zero-intrusion secondary development. **AI-Native** Built-in **AI Agent** module for admin AI chat, streaming responses, and automated tasks; **MCP service** exposes system tools to AI clients via `/api/mcp`, so humans and AI can operate the mall together. In the AI era, stability is the highest form of intelligence. **Multi-Terminal** One uni-app codebase covers **H5, WeChat Mini Program, and APP**. The admin panel is Vue 3 + Element Plus with front/back separation and real-time data sync for multi-channel operations. --- ### 📝 **CRMEB Ecosystem Marketplace** **Ecosystem Plugins** Browse the CRMEB marketplace for official curated plugins with continuous updates, professional support, and one-click upgrades — tailored to industry needs without deep technical skills. **One-Click Import** The system itself is plugin-based: product types, marketing campaigns, payments, logistics, distribution, content & community, analytics, third-party services, and industry customizations all plug in. Install what you need without touching core code or conflicting with upgrades. Import once and use immediately. **Publish Plugins** Use with ease — or earn with ease. Besides official plugins, developers can upload their own. Build industry-specific capabilities on the open-source AI foundation and list them on the marketplace. When others pay to download your work, you share the revenue — turning technical craft into income while growing the open-source mall ecosystem. We are not building “just another storefront.” How far a system goes depends on how many people are willing to build on it. Missing a plugin? Tell the official team. Have a great plugin? Bring it and talk. CRMEB Marketplace: Plugin Market ![Marketplace](help/images/插件市场.png) --- ### 🧩 **Mid-platform Core Capabilities** | Mid-platform | Description | | --- | --- | | **Product Mid-platform** | Product master data separated from type extensions; shared categories, SKUs, attributes, reviews, and stats across types. Modular product types with built-in physical goods and cloud-disk products; custom types supported | | **Trade Mode Registry** | “How a product is sold” decoupled from “what a product is”: built-in normal purchase and membership trade modes handle promotional pricing, order validation, and lifecycle hooks; more playbooks register via the registry | | **Order Mid-platform** | Multi-type orders unified with product snapshots and status logs; order-type adapters unify status trees, payment status, action buttons, and progress | | **After-sales & Refund Mid-platform** | Unified after-sales applications and line items; product types declare available after-sales types and time windows via a rule registry; unified refund tickets + idempotent refund side-effect records; supports refund-only, return & refund, exchange, and repair | | **User & Assets** | User-centric aggregation of addresses, tags, levels, membership, balance, points, commission, coupons, invoices, and referral relationships | --- ### 📦 **Modules & Drivers** Currently 22 modules and 30 drivers. Fresh install defaults to 7 modules (1 required + 6 default) and 15 drivers. Manage them under Admin → Extension Management (physical goods is a protected base module and cannot be uninstalled). **Built-in Modules** | Module | Capability | | --- | --- | | Physical Goods | Common products & SKUs, logistics / delivery / pickup fulfillment (protected base module) | | Cloud Disk Products | Digital goods, auto-delivered after payment | | H5 Browser | H5 channel access and user auth | | WeChat Mini Program | Mini Program channel access and user auth | | Check-in | Consecutive / cumulative check-in rules, points rewards, records | | AI Agent | Admin AI chat, streaming responses, automated tasks, and run records | | MCP Service | `POST /api/mcp` exposes system tools to AI clients with independent key auth | **Built-in Drivers** | Category | Built-in Drivers | | --- | --- | | Payment | WeChat Pay, WeChat Pay V3 | | Cloud Storage | Local storage, Alibaba Cloud OSS | | SMS / Email | Yihaotong SMS, QQ Mail | | Bots | WeCom bot, DingTalk bot, Feishu bot | | Logistics & Fulfillment | Yihaotong tracking, e-waybill, e-invoice, product scraping | | Cloud Print | Feie Cloud, Yilianyun | --- ### 🫧 **Technical Highlights** ~~~ Secondary development: 1. Coding standards: PSR-12 naming, RESTful APIs, strict Controller→Services→Dao→Model layering, complete comments, unified response body {status,msg,data}; 2. Permission management: flexible RBAC — menus are permission rules down to each menu and action button; 3. Module scaffolding: php think make:module generates compliant skeletons (plugins, product types, drivers, trade modes, marketing observers); 4. Architecture guard: php think arch:check scans the three-layer dependency rule, cross-module imports, events, and comment conventions — CI-ready; 5. System events: dual event registries for core and modules; listeners attach at event anchors and load with module install state; 6. Scheduled tasks: dual timer systems for core and modules, auto-registered on module install; 7. API management: visual route management, import, and online debugging in admin; 8. Form engine: PHP form-builder on the backend, @form-create on the frontend; 9. Code generation: quickly generate admin menus, pages, and CRUD; 10. Docs: Chinese project docs under help/docs (overview, architecture, features, DB design, deploy, ops); admin can connect MCP knowledge services (doc/route/schema search); 11. AI development kit: .crmeb ships AI coding rules, skills, and sub-agents compatible with mainstream AI coding tools. ~~~ ~~~ Performance & extensibility: 1. Security: JWT auth, role checks, operation logs, production logs, file integrity checks, data backup; 2. Performance: Redis cache, think-queue, Workerman long-connection gateway, multi cloud storage, cluster-ready; 3. i18n: admin and storefront multilanguage (vue-i18n) with browser language detection; 4. Driver extensions: ten categories — payment, upload, SMS, email, logistics, e-waybill, printing, bots, scraping, invoices — switch vendors freely for the same capability; 5. Realtime: unified WebSocket gateway (/ws) for admin realtime notifications and more; 6. Yihaotong: shared third-party extension for SMS, tracking, e-waybill, e-invoice, and product scraping. ~~~ --- ### 📖 **Features**
Admin features (click to expand) - **Workbench**: business metrics, order/user trends, sales rankings, pending reminders - **Products**: product mid-platform, categories, multi-spec SKUs, attribute templates, reviews, scrape / import / export - **Orders**: unified order mid-platform list & detail, ship / split ship, price & remark edits, tracking, invoices - **After-sales & Refunds**: review, return receive, unified refund tickets, original-path refunds, idempotent side effects - **Users**: groups, tags, levels, asset adjustments, account cancellation - **Membership**: packages, benefits, paid membership - **Marketing**: coupons, points, check-in campaigns - **Page Builder**: DIY drag-and-drop storefront, one-click theme colors, bottom nav, splash ads, articles - **Store & Delivery**: pickup, clerk verification, freight templates, e-waybill, cloud print - **Finance**: fund flows, payment channel config, business stats - **Notifications**: in-app, SMS, email, Official Account templates, Mini Program subscribe messages, bots - **WeChat Ecosystem**: Official Account OAuth / menu / media / replies; Mini Program login / subscribe messages - **Extensions**: install/uninstall/enable/disable modules & drivers; admin roles & permissions; config; timers; system logs & backup
Storefront features (click to expand) - **Browse & Cart**: DIY home, category search, product detail, cart, combined checkout with coupons / points / balance - **Orders & Pay**: multi-status order management, WeChat Pay / balance, tracking, reviews - **After-sales**: dynamic after-sales forms, progress timeline, return logistics - **Profile**: balance bills, points, coupons, membership benefits, addresses, message center - **Engagement**: check-in for points, coupon claiming

### 🚀 **Quick Start** --- ### 📱 Demo Admin: http://v8.crmeb.net/admin Account: `demo` / Password: `crmeb.com` H5: http://v8.crmeb.net/ (open on mobile) Themes: https://www.crmeb.com/theme (desktop) Plugins: https://www.crmeb.com/plugin (desktop) ![QR Code](help/images/%E5%BC%80%E6%BA%90PHP1.jpg) --- **Host environment (recommended)** ```bash # 1. Backend cd backend composer install php think run --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8011 # 2. Admin (dev server default port 1619; /adminapi proxies to 8011) cd frontend/admin npm ci npm run dev # 3. Mobile cd frontend/uni-app npm install npm run dev:h5 # H5; WeChat Mini Program: npm run dev:mp-weixin ``` **Backend daemons** ```bash cd backend php think queue:listen --queue # Message queue (Supervisor) php think timer start --d # Scheduled tasks php think workerman start --d # WebSocket long-connection gateway ``` **Docker Compose (optional)** ```bash ./run.sh start # Start (Nginx 8011 / MySQL 33061 / Redis 63791 / WebSocket 40001) ./run.sh ps # Status ./run.sh logs # Logs ``` **Frontend one-liners (`run.sh`)** ```bash ./run.sh admin:dev # Admin dev server (port 1619) ./run.sh admin:build # Build admin and publish to backend/public/admin ./run.sh uni:dev # Mobile H5 dev server ./run.sh uni:build # Build mobile H5 and publish to backend/public ``` > Default URLs: `http://localhost:8011`, admin at `http://localhost:8011/admin`. > DB and other settings follow `backend/.env`.
